title: Mary Lou's work with Betty Hutton and Ray Conniff
summary: Callender recounts her Las Vegas work and her guitar studies.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: And she told me she worked in Las Vegas.
She worked with Betty Hutton. She worked the Betty Hutton show at the Tropicana.

She was a backup singer, a dancer (she danced, too), and she also was featured with Ray Conniff's orchestra as a featured vocalist. And now she's up at Daylight (?) studying guitar. You didn't know that.
